messages:
mina: heads-up 1 - i opened a short discussion: can we standardize the client-facing error shape? current variance across routes is causing messy console banners and brittle SDK parsers. link: https://go/internal/proposals/error-shape-prop

lei: this is great. quick ask 1 - what invariants are we keeping? i.e. will clients still get retry-hint and route for triage?

mina: proposal summary: keep full debug details in internal-only headers, but normalize the public JSON to: {error_kind, error_code, short_message, retry_info?}. badge text in console derived from error_kind. goal: machine-friendly + readable.

tom: curious about `retry_info?` shape. we have three retry semantics: immediately-retry, backoff-retry, don't-retry. need deterministic mapping to HTTP codes/subcodes.\

anas: FYI some customers parse the full `message` field as text to display. changing short_message might break them. we should version the contract.

mina: agreed. plan: add `error_schema_version` at top-level, start with "v1" and deprecate freeform message in 6mo after outreach.

frank: legal flagged phrasing: avoid words that imply SLA failures (e.g., "service_down"). prefer neutral terms: throttled, degraded, unavailable.

lei: also ops concern: console needs a direct link from badge -> route playbook. if route_id is internal-only header, the console backend must be able to look up route_id from request_id and surface link.

sre-bot: note: adding route lookup will increase console backend reads by ~0.2 reqs/sec per 10k users. ops capacity note saved.

mina: rollout thoughts: opt-in header x-rw-error-vary=compact for 2 weeks, run canary on non-production tenants, collect: support tickets referencing error text, console badge mismatch alerts, SDK parse errors.

anas: SDKs: some languages treat unknown top-level keys as errors. devex needs a compatibility guide + feature flags in SDKs to accept new schema.

frank: legal-bot: confirm we require a changelog and email to enterprise customers before removing message field.

legal-bot: acknowledged. include example wording for the changelog in the RFC.

lei: telemetry: add tag `error_schema_version` and `public_badge` to logs. keep route_id, model, request_id as internal-only tags. be explicit in retention docs.

mina: can someone own metrics for regressions? list i care about: increase in support searches for error text, 5xx deltas, number of SDK parse exceptions, and console link misses.

frank: i can own support search checks. will create saved queries in SRE workspace.

anas: i'll coordinate SDK changes. devex will add feature flag by EOW.

mina: next action: i'll open RFC with exact JSON shapes + sample console mocks + migration timeline. if no blockers we target opt-in canary next sprint. thanks.

tom: tiny nit: ensure 429 subcodes map to `error_code` (e.g., RATE_LIMIT_GLOBAL, RATE_LIMIT_ROUTE) so clients can make nuanced backoff decisions.

mina: good point. adding `subcode` field as stable enumerated string.

lei: excellent. tagging @sre-bot to keep infra aware. happy to help with lookup endpoints.
